title: Battle for Zendikar Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: An ambush leader on Zendikar who speaks of bringing down Eldrazi.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker who arrived at Sea Gate too late to prevent the massacre but led its survivors to relative safety.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A place on Zendikar where a massacre occurred.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrous beings that hunger without limit and consume without pause, spreading across Zendikar.

entities.name: Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan, a force as voracious as time itself, once falsely remembered by merfolk as the god Ula.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A being who boasts of watching a world fall to its knees.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A being who warns Jace Beleren that the Eldrazi came as three.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A figure to whom Ugin speaks about the threat of Ulamog.

entities.name: Drana, Liberator of Malakir
entities.description: A Kalastria bloodchief vampire who refuses to live as a slave and calls others to fight alongside her.

entities.name: Kalastria
entities.description: A vampire bloodline led by Drana as bloodchief.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: A place Drana is named the liberator of.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane being ravaged by the Eldrazi, defended by its inhabitants.

entities.name: Goma Fada
entities.description: A place on Zendikar with a hero who rallies others.

entities.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
entities.description: A character who speaks of hedrons holding magic.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A figure whose connection to Zendikar is restored, letting her feel the plane's power surge through her.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A former lullmage who turned to rousing Zendikar's fury instead of allaying it.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar beneath dense vegetation.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A volcanic continent of Zendikar with gas vents and jagged peaks.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar, a vast plateau crisscrossed by trenches and rivers.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar, a geothermal swampland.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar with rushing waters and mist-cloaked lakes.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan falsely remembered by merfolk as the god Emeria.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan falsely remembered by merfolk as the god Cosi.

entities.name: Hedron
entities.description: Magical stones that hold magic for a thousand years and can bind the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Gideon arrives at Sea Gate too late to prevent the massacre but leads its survivors to relative safety.
events.quote: Though Gideon arrived at Sea Gate too late to prevent the massacre, he still had enough time to lead its survivors to relative safety.

events.summary: Ugin warns Jace Beleren that the Eldrazi came as three.
events.quote: You speak to me of the threat of Ulamog. But do not forget: they came as three.

events.summary: Nissa's connection to Zendikar is restored.
events.quote: Her connection to the plane restored, Nissa felt the power of Zendikar surge through her.

events.summary: Noyan Dar turns from allaying Zendikar's fury to rousing it.
events.quote: Noyan Dar turned his talents from allaying Zendikar's fury to the considerably easier task of rousing it.

events.summary: The last hedron is slotted into place, binding Ulamog in an infinite loop of energy.
events.quote: The last hedron slotted into place, locking Ulamog in an infinite loop of binding energy.

events.summary: It is revealed the merfolk gods Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were false memories of the Eldrazi titans.
events.quote: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity: the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek.

On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents
